categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Prisemi Electronics Co., Ltd. (Prisemi) primarily engages in the design, research, and sales of power semiconductor devices and power ICs. Its main product lines include TVS (Transient Voltage Suppressors), MOSFETs, Schottky diodes, GaN HEMT devices, IGBTs, and power management ICs. These products serve various applications in consumer electronics, network communications, security, industrial, automotive electronics, and energy storage sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor technologies including planar and trench MOSFET processes, deep trench isolation, NPN structures, and improved trench MOS Schottky diode technology. It also develops third-generation semiconductor devices such as GaN HEMT and SiC power devices. The company operates under a fabless model, focusing on design and R&D while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Prisemi's key customers include major domestic smartphone brands like Xiaomi, TCL, and Transsion, as well as ODM manufacturers such as Huaqin, Wingtech, and Longcheer. Its products are widely used in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, laptops, TWS), network communications, security devices, industrial equipment, automotive electronics, and emerging fields like AI and 5G infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with its headquarters and main R&D centers located in Shanghai and Wuxi. Domestic sales dominate its revenue, accounting for over 90%, while exports mainly target Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. The company plans to expand its overseas market presence by following its domestic brand customers' international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Prisemi operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design company. It focuses on product design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors. It maintains close cooperation with leading wafer and packaging suppliers to ensure product supply and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in power semiconductor technologies, focusing on enhancing product performance, miniaturization, and energy efficiency. Key R&D directions include developing advanced TVS, MOSFET, Schottky, GaN HEMT, IGBT, and SiC devices, as well as expanding power IC product lines for charging and protection applications. It also invests in talent acquisition, digital transformation, brand building, and expanding into new markets such as automotive electronics, renewable energy, and AI.
categories.revenue_model: Prisemi generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor products, including power devices and power management ICs. Its sales are conducted mainly via a distribution model supplemented by direct sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at the point of delivery or customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international semiconductor manufacturers such as Texas Instruments, ON Semiconductor, and Semtech in the power semiconductor market. Prisemi positions itself as a leading domestic power semiconductor design company with advanced proprietary technologies, aiming to capture growing market share driven by China's push for domestic substitution and innovation in semiconductor components.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Prisemi achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 352.9 million, representing a 10.15% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 111.6 million, up 15.7%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 2.33 billion and equity of RMB 2.26 billion, showing steady growth and positive cash flow from operations. R&D investment accounted for about 10% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Prisemi emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities and proprietary core technologies that enable high-performance, low-loss, and miniaturized power semiconductor products. Its products offer superior surge protection, low conduction resistance, and high reliability, tailored to meet the evolving needs of consumer electronics and emerging industries. The company leverages its fabless model for flexibility and cost efficiency, combined with a customer-centric approach and robust supply chain partnerships to deliver high-quality, innovative solutions.
